note: Small, mostly long-term park on US 59 just off I-29 north of St. Joseph, with a few pull-through sites for overnighters; some sites paved with patios and shade. A 2026 reviewer reports road noise at the front pull-throughs. --Claude
summary: Operator site + RoverPass engine read: $40/night (one RV rate, Jan and June 2027), 32 sites (4 pull-through), all full hookup 30/50A, showers + laundry, open year-round, request-to-book on RoverPass. Changed site count 26->32. Mostly long-term per a 2026 reviewer; passes the long-stay tests on the evidence.
flags: Price gate: $40/night on the operator's RoverPass engine (2027 Jan + June, weekday and Saturday; cart $40 site + RoverPass platform/processing fees, $0 tax). Presence: own website with phone + bookable RoverPass listing; Google 4.5 over 157 reviews; RV Life 4* over 85 (reviewers 8-10/2026 paid $30-60, 8-10 ratings).

Long-stay character: the operator offers 'DAILY, WEEKLY, AND MONTHLY RATES'; an RV Life reviewer (stayed 9/2026) wrote 'Almost all long term, just a few pull alongside transient spots. Only about 20 total spots in a pretty tight space.' Five tests: (1) $40 passes; (2) nightly rate sold on RoverPass (request-to-book, no application) passes; (3) min 1 night passes; (4) no count of nightly sites published - the 4 pull-throughs of 32 would be 1 in 8, so passes as far as counted; (5) an RV park, no homes. I read it as mostly long-term but passing; the note says so.
PHONE missing: the operator's site and Google give (816) 262-5799 (apply.py does not write phones).
Pin 39.8526,-94.8141 is ~60 m from Google's place point - fine.
